newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds rallied on the Swiss National Bank's (SNB) declaration that was adding significant quanitities of liquidity to the money market to offset the Swiss franc's recent gains.
The Swiss market closed off best levels but maintained much of the day's gains, while German and U.S. bonds weakened.
LIFFE June EuroSwiss futures and Swiss June medium-term Comi futures hit contract highs on Wednesday.
Some traders were now wondering if the SNB will consider a discount rate cut. The discount rate, last lowered in September to one percent, now matches the historic low of 1978/1979.

Meanwhile, a new Swiss government bond saw little demand. The government will set final terms on the 20-year issue on Thursday. Traders said the long maturity hurt demand. The maturity is too long for delivery against Conf futures.
Euro Swiss francs up eight at 98.41.
